correctness.rationale: The exact logarithmic coefficient of G_{p^a}=H_{p^a,1} is p^{a-r}/u for n=p^{aq+r}u, (p,u)=1. Writing m=p^s v and exp(m log G), every nonlinear j>=2 term has valuation at least j(s+1)-nu_p(j!)>=s+a+1 under s>=a if p=2, or s>=a-1 if odd. The unique lowest-valuation linear term therefore gives nu_p(S(n))=s+a-r and normalized mod-p unit v/u. At n=0 coefficient is one. Trailing-zero residue classes give stated natural densities and automaticity of the valuation levels. The actual recurrence script was inspected, and an independent finite integer-product expansion for 375 positive coefficients across five families reproduced both formulas.
